ss run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/cancel-an-in-flight-readiness-run.md): The executing node learns
about this on its next heartbeat and aborts the run in flight, which matters more than the row's status: the thing being stopped
is traffic to somebody else's server.\n- [Resume a stopped readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readines
s/resume-a-stopped-readiness-run.md): Runs again a run that stopped on the server before it finished, which the run detail reports
as `resumable: true`. The server is graded with the caller's credentials, so only the person who started the run can resume it. T
he run keeps the inputs it started with, and the request has no body. Poll the…\n- [Fetch a readiness run's full report](https://d

ence lane as `heuristic` or `manual-review`; they can never decide a lane. `404` when the run has no stored report: it may be in…\
